description: A painted schoolroom scene. On the left, a woman in a black dress, white shawl and bonnet writes on a chalkboard. Several girls with dark skin sit at wooden desks in period dresses, writing with quills on slates. Through a tall multi-pane window, a group of men in top hats and dark coats gesture and shout outside, with a few houses and bare trees beyond. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text.
